top_signals.title: Dr Reddy's CEO On Clogged Semaglutide Pipeline
top_signals.summary: Dr Reddy's CEO Erez Israeli expects a healthy performance in the second half of FY2026-27 once the company resolves the semaglutide issue. Israeli believes the generics market for semaglutide in will be ultra-competitive, with more than 20 companies trying to gain market share. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Manila Electric Loses $2 Billion Value as Reform Plan Weighs
top_signals.summary: Manila Electric Co. shares extended their decline to a fourth day, erasing about 127 billion pesos ($2 billion) in market capitalization amid growing concern that a proposal to eliminate a power charge for consumers could hurt the utility’s earnings.
